note: SPM hero #10 The Juggler. Silent scroll-scrubbed hero: no music, no SFX. Marks are beats on a nominal 120 bpm grid (1 beat = 0.5 s). Catch times are computed in film.js: each ball is thrown from the owner's hand on the catcher's side at its first throw after <role>_in + 0.5 s, and lands 0.62 s later.
title: SPM — The Juggler (hero scroll film)
